post.instagram_caption:
Who is next in your OPD?

India has issued nearly 24 crore Scan & Register tokens for faster OPD registration, says the Health Ministry. But in a typical hospital, the queue inside still runs on paper slips and a register.

Give every patient a token for their doctor, see who is booked, waiting or seen, and bill the fee and tests when the visit ends, all on one OPD screen.

Try a live demo with sample data at resolveai.cc, no sign-up.

Source: Health Ministry figures reported by DD News and IBEF.
